title: Expose the SRP default VID parameter at protocol_processor_top for parent configuration binding
body:
[A10] Parent configuration-truth prerequisite for kebag-logic/milan-fpga#400.

## Objective and evidence

At donor 424c688fa2205b934a7689a58f2aa766420f2326, protocol_processor_top instantiates KL_srp_top without binding DOM_DEF_VID_P. The child therefore uses its independent 16-bit default 2. Parent-generated CSR, boot and tag defaults cannot drive that source. Parent #400 explicitly requires a physical parameter path, not merely an equality check.

## Authority and scope

Milan v1.2 4.2.7.2.1 requires startup/Link-Up default VID 2 and adoption of a received alternate class-A Domain. Read the donor SRP requirements and architecture, hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv and hdl/srp/KL_srp_top.sv. Expose the existing child's default-VID parameter at the top and bind it without changing its width or default. Document the interface and prove the binding. Normal product defaults remain 2; a non-2 value is only a verification fixture proving parameter propagation, not a shipping profile.

No timer-policy, priority, Domain-adoption, MVRP, frame-format or microprogram change is included.

## Acceptance and validation

1. A named 16-bit top parameter defaults to 2 and drives KL_srp_top.DOM_DEF_VID_P directly. The interface documentation identifies default/startup semantics and preserves network adoption.
2. A top-level executable test observes the default value and a distinct verification-only parameter value through the actual instantiated SRP path. A planted missing/misbound connection must fail that test; a direct child-only test is insufficient.
3. Existing Domain adoption and Link Down/Up behavior remain covered; run the focused top/SRP regressions and all mandatory donor gates on the exact candidate.
4. Two independent positive reviews, clean applicable lens coverage and the donor merge/containment workflow are required before the parent pin changes. Parent #400 then binds the new parameter from its generated declaration and validates tag/default agreement.

Dependencies: none for this donor interface extension; parent #400 depends on its merged result. Conflicts: active donor top/SRP parameter lanes, to be checked before takeover.
Executor and independent reviewers: unassigned until takeover. No implementation starts from this filing. Decision: preserve existing width, default and runtime behavior; expose the already-existing default source.
